# ubuntu_systemd_unit_info Data Source

Reads systemd_unit_info data via the hostsession.

## Example Usage

```hcl
data "ubuntu_systemd_unit_info" "example" {
  target = var.host
  name = "example"
}
```
## Argument Reference

The data source accepts the following arguments:

- `name` (Required, string) - Systemd unit name to inspect (for example kubelet or containerd.service).
- `port` (Optional, Computed, int64) - Target port for this data source. Overrides provider default_target.port.
- `target` (Optional, Computed, string) - Target host or address for this data source. Overrides provider default_target.target.
- `transport` (Optional, Computed, string) - Transport for this data source. The current provider surface supports ssh.

## Attribute Reference

In addition to the configured arguments, this data source exports the following attributes:

- `active_state` (string) - Raw systemd ActiveState value.
- `enabled` (bool) - Whether the unit is enabled at boot.
- `id` (string) - Unique identifier for this data source.
- `load_state` (string) - Raw systemd LoadState value.
- `masked` (bool) - Whether the unit is masked.
- `sub_state` (string) - Raw systemd SubState value.
- `unit_file_state` (string) - Raw systemd UnitFileState value.
